claim: Results describe a regular-expression clause extractor on small hand-authored synthetic document sets. They are NOT a model-accuracy claim and do not generalise to real agreements. Small samples: see the Wilson 95% intervals.

how_to_read.baseline_before_hardening: Development set measured BEFORE the extractor hardening (the honest 'unseen' result on those 18 documents).
how_to_read.development_set_after_hardening: Same 18 documents AFTER hardening designed from the baseline failures: OPTIMISTIC (the extractor was tuned on them).
how_to_read.held_out_set: 8 documents authored AFTER the hardening with variations it was not designed for: the fairer estimate of current behaviour.

reviewer_correction_time_note: Not measured: no human reviewer study was run.
